grid-news-gn-ng-nigeria-2026112017.cause_summary: No page I could open states a cause for the 20 November 2026 Nigeria power disruption. A Daily Post headline says NISO dismissed a grid collapse claim, but the page could not be read.

grid-news-gn-ru-russia-2026111910.cause_summary: No page I read states a cause for a Russian outage on 19 November 2026. Searches in English and Russian returned only Ukrainian reports for that date; the report may concern Ukraine, not Russia.

grid-news-gn-ua-dnipro-2026111902.cause_summary: Fakty ICTV, relaying Ukrenergo, reported emergency outages in four regions including Dnipropetrovsk because of damaged energy equipment after Russian attacks; the ministry said repeat strikes slow repairs. Not a cyber cause.

grid-news-gn-ua-zaporizhzhia-2026112106.cause_summary: Local outlet mig.com.ua reported hourly outage schedules for Zaporizhzhia and the region on 21-22 November but states no cause. No operator, regulator or government statement on the cause was found.
